title: FEATURE REQUEST: Different "Carb absorption rate" for food with different glycemic index
symptom: The user requests an improvement to the 'Predictive Simulation Settings' in xDrip, specifically that the 'Carb absorption rate' should be customizable for different types of carbs (fast/med/slow) based on glycemic index, similar to how multiple insulin types are handled.
evidence_quote: I have idea to improve "Predictive Simulation Settings". You can there set "Carb absorption rate". It's important parameter. That's why I think it should be improved.
